correctness.rationale: For k=2, r in {1,2,3,4} odds gives exactly each t mod4 with both parities and independent s adjustment by +2. For each k>=2, adding 2^k to one entry toggles only the first top bit; moving 2^(k-1) between one even and one odd entry toggles only the quadratic top bit, preserving all lower bits and mixed parity. Thus all four lifts exist inductively. For k>=3, sum-of-four-squares zero mod8 implies all four entries even with total sum divisible by four, so (2,0) is inaccessible. k=1,2 boundaries established explicitly. Exact finite sumset and lift checks pass through k=7 and k=4 respectively. Infinite proof does not rely on them.

value.rationale: A natural exact local additive-basis invariant of the dyadic parabola is determined for every prime-power exponent, including the nonlinear five-variable existence threshold and a sharp mod-eight obstruction. The two-coordinate moment problem is arithmetically richer than the separately counted square-sum congruence, and the parity-preserving lifting construction is reusable for related local power-sum maps. No unproved downstream applications are asserted.
